environment.description: Same Actix-web binary deployed behind an Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) with a custom Lua filter chain. The Envoy configuration includes: (1) a route-level filter on POST /login that strips any form field named 'session_token' and removes the 'X-Preflight-Session' header from non-internal traffic (identified by missing mTLS client cert from the service mesh CA), (2) a response filter that rewrites Set-Cookie headers to enforce __Host- prefix semantics with Secure;HttpOnly;SameSite=Strict attributes regardless of application-set values, and (3) static asset responses include Content-Security-Policy headers with require-sri-for directives and the Envoy file-serving filter validates SHA-384 digests against a pinned manifest at /etc/envoy/sri-manifest.json before serving any .js file, returning 403 if the file hash doesn't match the manifest entry. The mTLS requirement on /api/preflight-session means only mesh-internal services with valid SPIFFE identities can call that endpoint.

config.proxy: Envoy 1.28 sidecar with Lua filter chain
config.filter_1: route filter strips 'session_token' form field and 'X-Preflight-Session' header from external requests (no valid mTLS client cert)
config.filter_2: response filter rewrites all Set-Cookie to __Host- prefix with Secure;HttpOnly;SameSite=Strict
config.filter_3: static file serving validates SHA-384 against /etc/envoy/sri-manifest.json, 403 on mismatch
config.mtls: SPIFFE-based mTLS required for /api/preflight-session from mesh-internal only
config.network: private subnet, only Envoy ingress exposed via internal ALB
